name: Café Pizzeria Capricorno
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Café Pizzeria Capricorno in Tirol! Indulge in authentic Italian flavors right in the heart of the Alps.
beschreibung: The Café Pizzeria Capricorno in Tarrenz in the Imst region combines Tyrolean hospitality with genuine Italian flavors. Guests can indulge in crispy, freshly baked pizzas from the stone oven, classic pasta dishes, and homemade desserts, alongside a full range of coffee and drink options. The inviting dining area and warm service provide the perfect venue for family gatherings, casual dinners, or an enjoyable meal after an outdoor excursion.
